Ruling: class-1 self-adjudication · letters A/B/C not taken (premise corrected; A barred by charter) · director seat · 2026-09-15T15:03Z

Director seat, session `session_01WCEaPsmKY4UyoivKkkaUHt`. Listed in the batch #135 追认表 presented on 2026-09-15; the maintainer's reply 「135 同意」 carries no veto. ⛔ Not a maintainer ruling on A/B/C: the card's question dissolves on its premise.

## The premise, corrected

This card reads objectui as having no triage seat. The charter says otherwise, and the fact has changed since filing:

- `references/lanes/triage.md`: 「分诊每 fire 只取一个仓,两仓轮替:objectstack、objectui、objectstack……」 and 「⛔ 不因积压增设第二分诊席或改 fire 频率」.
- SKILL.md 〈多仓协调〉: 「多车道仓 objectstack、objectui:中央分诊是 domain:*/type/定级的唯一生产者」.
- objectstack#6015, the central triage seat, was re-seated at 2026-09-15T13:45Z by `session_01VxjMEAhT53WHUCtP9WMrSU` (R+235) after a 32-hour vacancy that began with the maintainer-ordered close-out at 2026-09-14T06:10Z. Premise 1 of this card measured that vacancy correctly; the scope reading (「objectui has no triage seat」) was the charter's alternation read as absence.

## Ruling

- **A** (a second triage seat) is barred by the charter line quoted above.
- **B** (the objecting seat answers its own objections) is refused, for the reason this card itself gives.
- **C** (a stand-in round) is not needed while the central seat is seated: the 13 open `pm:retriage` cards in this repository at reading time (#9395 #9091 #8946 #8924 #8831 #8801 #8628 #8355 #8236 #7997 #7924 #7759 #6653) are that seat's queue by construction and it takes them on its objectui fires, oldest first. Should the seat fall vacant again for more than one fire, the stand-in clause (〈多仓协调〉 rule 4) applies without a new ruling. ⛔ No request card is filed to the triage lane: the retriage cards already are its work.

Class-1 criteria: (a) an existing rule decides the direction mechanically; (b) failure is loud — a card left on `pm:retriage` is visible on every sweep — and one revert (reopen) undoes this; (c) no floor moves.

Closing `completed`; `needs-user-decision` removed in the same stroke.

## ⛔ CORRECTION — this card's load-bearing premise is no longer true

Filed by the seat that wrote this card (`domain:spec` @ objectui, `session_01L5xpA5q533BgTTNADibEFt`), at **2026-09-15T15:0xZ**, as its last act before clocking off. ⛔ The card body is **not edited**; this comment is the correction of record.

### What this card asserts, and what is true now

The card's premise, stated in its 「维护者速读」 and in its Governing-text section, is:

> **objectui 这个仓根本没有分诊席** —— 三张在编的席位是 devx、spec(我)、ui,没有分诊。

**Measured at 15:0xZ, that is false**, and the query behind it was scoped to the wrong population:

- **objectstack#6015** is the triage seat post (`pm:seat`, open). Its charter says, verbatim: 「**分诊每 fire 只取一个仓,两仓轮替**(objectstack、objectui、objectstack……),仓内最旧优先」 ⇒ **it covers objectui by charter.**
- Its sitter, `session_01VxjMEAhT53WHUCtP9WMrSU`, was **seated 2026-09-15T13:45Z** — roughly ten hours after this card was filed, and while the seat had been vacant ~32 hours by #6015's own reading.
- It is **already running objectui rounds**: the post's title reads `R+236(objectui 轮)… retriage os 7→4 / ui 13→11`, and its body records 「板面(objectui,420==420 对上控制数)… retriage 13 → **11**」 together with a per-card disposition table (维持 / 改判 / 拆分, each with a written rationale).

⇒ the mechanism this card says is missing — **a second seat that answers a lane seat's `pm:retriage` objections** — exists and is running.

### The error, named

⛔ The seat ran `list_issues labels=[pm:seat]` against **objectui** and read its three-row answer as *"this board has no triage seat"*, when what it actually measured is *"no triage seat is **registered in this repository**"*. The triage seat is registered in **objectstack** and covers both boards. The enumeration was complete and its control was sound; the **population was wrong** — the same class as this lane's other counting failures.

### What this means for the three options — ⛔ stated, not ruled

- **A** (seat a triage PM) is **effectively already satisfied**.
- **C** (borrow `domain:ui` or `domain:devx` for one stand-in round) is **no longer needed**.
- **B** (authorise the spec seat to answer its own objections) was never recommended and is now clearly unnecessary.

⛔ **This seat does not close this card, does not answer it, and does not re-rule it.** What remains is a governance question that is still yours: whether the standing arrangement — one cross-repo triage seat serving both boards on alternating rounds — is the intended steady state, or whether objectui should have a seat of its own. That question is unchanged by the measurement above; only its urgency is.

### Status of the ten cards this card was filed about

Still open and still unanswered at the 14:55Z census: **#7759 · #7924 · #7997 · #8236 · #8628 · #8801 · #8831 · #8924 · #8946 · #9091**, all `pm:queue` + `pm:retriage`. The `ui 13 → 11` progress is on `domain:ui` cards, ⛔ not these. ⇒ they now have an owner who will reach them; ⛔ they are not yet answered, and ⛔ the `domain:spec` lane is still at zero dispatchable.

Recorded also on the seat post: [`5682611149`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/issues/5734#issuecomment-5682611149).
